items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: And they named them -- as far as they got it, it was Joe, Earl and Edward and Roosevelt.

ctx.x: And they named them -- as far as they got it, it was Joe, Earl and Edward and Roosevelt. They didn't know -- and there was one child born the same time, another child born and they thought that there was born in so and so, and they named off the children, but they wasn't sure about the time they was born, but what they had found.
